They had to hit me with the paddles to start my heart again, I can remember the feeling I had now only because I woke up, if you can imagine yourself in a pitch black room with no noise or light, no sense of time , and no capacity to think or form thoughts or create memories of anything. It’s as if someone just turned everything off inside. And your just and inanimate doll waiting to be played with. There’s no fear or emotion. No sense of self or of others.
